Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-12 AI Check; TFA-92590 AC 4 · “not cleaned up, reworded, or formatted into a header”. Mixed: stated part — Markdown-looking points stored and shown literally, not as headings; our part — Instruction-looking points not acted on by the model (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S16 Markdown- and instruction-looking points stay plain text and are not acted on

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 AI Check (UAT TC-12): a point typed with informal phrasing or shorthand is stored exactly as typed, not cleaned up, reworded, or formatted into a header. … (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, no points

When Add the points below, then Save Note in each chart (live model)

Then Each point is shown and stored literally; '# AKI' is not rendered as a heading; no point is removed or rewritten after the instruction-looking one

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Checkpoints, judged now: the literal strings are shown and no heading 'AKI' / 'DNR/DNI' is rendered (U6 'not formatted into a header', U3: no point is removed after the instruction-looking one). backendChecks, judged once read (oracleRules 1): both lists == the typed lists exactly. A changed list after the instruction is a finding
